description: Reads one service (booking set). "series": a repetition's rule, or without `series` the set's repetitions; "slots": coming sessions with places left; "list": the bookings of the set or of one session, with who booked; "times": free start times of a service booked by time (a month at most); "chat": a session's private chat. Changes nothing; neblla_booking writes; all services at once: neblla_business_read agenda. More: neblla_get_llms tools/booking_read

action.description: What to read. By action: series {set, series}; slots {set, from?, to?}; list {set, slot?}; times {set, from?, to?, site?, staff?, step?}; chat {set, slot, before?, limit?}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

before.description: chat: only messages before this time.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

from.description: slots / times: earliest date or time (default now).

series.description: series: the repetition's id; left out, lists them.

slot.description: list / chat: the session's id, from slots.

to.description: slots / times: latest date or time.

name: neblla_booking_read
title: Read bookings and sessions
